question: Can different English sentence encoders improve on the trained GTE-base plus GTE-small equal vote in group-held-out preference tasks?
comparison: On the original primary training fold, train one identical pair-aware, regularized linear head for each new frozen encoder and reuse both locked GTE control components. Compare each newcomer alone, in an equal three-component probability vote, and as a 50/50 vote against the incumbent ensemble. Whole connected groups of shared text stay within a fold. Never use released validation feedback for selecting a recipe.
gate: Per newcomer lock the single best strictly positive primary challenger, with ties going to the simpler and then more uniform option. Verify on a disjoint confirmation fold. Require positive gains on both and at least 0.003 pooled gain. The best qualifying challenger by worst-fold gain then pooled gain must strictly improve on a third group fold before it can be considered for a fresh autonomous course run. No winning member or order is passed to that run.
resources: At most six new supervised fits across the three folds, shared by all mixtures. No paid API, external answers or H2. Compute and compare training-only vectors from public immutable checkpoints. Record every tried configuration and every fit.
